issue_context.title: when creating index, log backup should be able to start
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
1. add index
2. start log backup
<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
done
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```
Unable to create log backup task. Please wait until the DDL jobs(add index with ingest method) are finished.
```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
7.1, 7.5, 8.1, master
<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

review_comments: This func is used when log backup is not compatible with fast create index. In 7.0+, it's useless.
